name: Mezepheles
ability: You start knowing a secret word. The 1st good player to say this word becomes evil that night.
setup: The Storyteller picks an unusual secret word during setup.
wakes: First night: wakes to be shown the secret word. Does not wake again; the player who said the word wakes on the night they turn evil.
interaction: Told the secret word on night 1. Chooses nothing. Is not told whether anyone turned evil. The converted player is shown the YOU ARE token and a thumbs down.
drunk_or_poisoned: What matters is the Mezepheles's state that night. If sober and healthy at night, the marked player turns evil even if the Mezepheles was drunk or poisoned when the word was said. If drunk or poisoned at night, the player stays good and the ability is spent (NO ABILITY); no further attempt.

rulings.text: The Storyteller must hear the good player say the word, publicly or privately; only the first good player counts.
The Mezepheles does not learn whether the conversion worked; the converted player learns it that night.
If the Mezepheles is executed (dies) on the day the word was said, they have no ability that night, so the player stays good.
If the Mezepheles is drunk or poisoned on the night of conversion, the player stays good and the Mezepheles cannot try again.

test_scenarios.name: conversion
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Mezepheles (word 'marmalade'), Bob Barber (good), Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob wakes, is shown YOU ARE + thumbs down; Bob's alignment is evil; Alice has NO ABILITY.

test_scenarios.name: evil speaker ignored
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Mezepheles, Dave Poisoner, Bob Chef (good).
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Dave says the word, then Bob says it. Night.
test_scenarios.expected: Dave is unaffected (already evil); Bob turns evil.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned at night
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Mezepheles, Erin Poisoner, Bob Noble.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 2: Bob says the word. Night 2: Erin poisons Alice before the Mezepheles step.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob stays good; Alice marked NO ABILITY; nobody turns evil later even if another good player says the word.

test_scenarios.name: mezepheles executed same day
test_scenarios.actions: Day 2: Bob says the word, then Alice is executed.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice dies; Bob stays good; no conversion that night.

test_scenarios.name: drunk when word said, sober at night
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Mezepheles, Frank Innkeeper, Bob Monk.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Frank protects Alice (Alice drunk until dusk). Day 2: Bob says the word. Night 2: Frank protects others; Alice sober.
